compensation.value: CHF 10,000 per semester, up to 4 semesters

description_short: EPFL Master Excellence Fellowships provide CHF 10,000 per semester for up to four semesters. Applicants tick the fellowship box on the Master application in IS-Academia; only applications paid and validated by 15 December are considered. Current EPFL Master students and Master holders are ineligible.

deadline.evidence_quote: only applications that are paid for and validated by 15 December at the latest will be considered

status_evidence: Official EPFL page describes the 15 December deadline as the new deadline for the 2027 fellowship (future)
